title: Model output envelope
description: The lead model's reply. Shape only. The host also checks that every candidate id is answered exactly once, that a severity_needed id is answered with confirm, and that a confirm for a candidate not in severity_needed carries summary and suggested_fix. If one of those fails, the reply is invalid and the repair turn applies. Two host checks never make the reply invalid. A finding whose rule_id is neither an llm rule nor a rule injected as not_evaluated for that finding's area is dropped, and the rest of the reply is kept. A severity outside the rule's permitted list, in a finding or a confirm, is capped to the highest permitted severity when it is above it, or raised to the lowest when it is below it. So a review.* finding may carry CRITICAL here: the host caps it. source, subject and confirmed_by are host-owned and never accepted here. counts is optional; a malformed counts makes the reply invalid, and a reply without counts has none, never zeros.

items.description: The seven finding fields, without the finding schema's review.* CRITICAL check: the host caps an out-of-list severity instead of rejecting the reply.

counts.description: The three summary-line counts of the full variant: items of origin other with instruction-like text, conversation and bot claims past the claim cap, and quoted claims the code did not confirm. All three, 0 included.

candidate_decision.description: confirm carries a severity, and summary and suggested_fix, which the host requires except for an id from severity_needed; reject carries none of them. An id from severity_needed takes confirm only, which the host checks. A severity outside the rule's list is capped or raised by the host, as for findings.
